text: What if you could rewind time by ten seconds? But only once a day.
Coffee on your white shirt. Rewind. Clean shirt. You start smiling like an idiot.
Someone roasts you in front of everyone. Rewind. This time, you have the perfect comeback.
A kid runs toward the street. A bus is coming. Rewind. You grab his arm before he moves.
First date. You say something stupid. Rewind. You say something smarter. She laughs anyway.
You rewind every awkward moment. Every pause. Every mistake. Your life gets smoother, and somehow quieter.
You decide not to use it. You trip, you say the wrong thing, you laugh about it. Best day in weeks.
Which moment would you rewind? Tell me in the comments.
